# Evaluation Rubric: Problem Framing

Use this rubric to evaluate the quality of the problem framing.

| Criteria | 1 - Poor | 3 - Good | 5 - Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Symptoms** | Jumped to solution | Focuses on symptoms in Q1 | Clearly distinguishes symptoms from solutions |
| **Stakeholders** | "Everyone" | Specific roles from `personas.md` | Identified overlooked/absent stakeholders |
| **Problem Statement** | Too broad / vague | Follows the template | Sharp, root-cause focused, and consequence-aware |
| **How Might We** | Solution disguised as Q | Open-ended question | Action-oriented with measurable objective |
| **Interactive Flow** | All Qs at once | One question per turn | Correct pacing; restates answers for clarity |
